$schema_note: Error envelope → typed error. Real runtime shape (api/v2/base_controller.rb#render_error): `{error:{type,message,details?,request_id,remediation?}}` — request_id and remediation are NESTED under `error`. request_id precedence: `X-Wf-Request-Id` response header > error.request_id > top-level request_id. Fallbacks when the body is not the envelope: type `api_error`, request_id from the header only. `message: null` in expect means 'any string' (HTTP status text is runtime-specific).
